record.paper_title: Open Problems on Open Algebraic Varieties (Montreal 1994 Problems)
record.context_brief: Analytic versus algebraic exotic affine space
record.original_question: Does there exist a pair of exotic C^n's that are biholomorphic but not isomorphic? Also, does there exist a non-trivial deformation family of exotic C^n's whose members all have the same underlying analytic structure?

evidence.quote:
QUESTION. Does there exist a pair of exotic Cn’s which are biholomorphic but
not isomorphic ? Does there exist a non-trivial deformation family of exotic Cn
’s with the
same underlying analytic structure ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
An exotic C^n is a smooth complex affine algebraic variety of dimension n that is diffeomorphic to R^{2n} (equivalently, contractible and of the correct dimension and at infinity behavior) but is not algebraically isomorphic to the affine space C^n.

(a) Do there exist two exotic C^n's X and Y that are biholomorphic as complex analytic manifolds but not isomorphic as algebraic varieties?

(b) Does there exist a non-trivial algebraic deformation family {X_t}_{t ∈ T} of exotic C^n's (i.e., a smooth morphism of algebraic varieties X → T whose closed fibers X_t are exotic C^n's, with non-isomorphic algebraic fibers for distinct parameters) such that all the fibers X_t are biholomorphic to one another as complex analytic manifolds?
artifact.status_search_result: There are known examples of smooth complex affine varieties (e.g., Danielewski surfaces, and Dubouloz's exotic affine 3-spheres) that are biholomorphic but not algebraically isomorphic, and even algebraic families of pairwise non-isomorphic varieties with the same underlying analytic structure. However, these examples are not exotic C^n's in the strict sense (contractible affine varieties diffeomorphic to R^{2n} that are not algebraically C^n). No source found that settles either part of the question specifically for exotic C^n's, so the status appears to remain unknown.

status_evidence.title: Families of exotic affine 3-spheres (Dubouloz–Moser-Jauslin–Poloni)
status_evidence.snippet: Smooth families of pairwise non-isomorphic affine threefolds diffeomorphic to S^3, with fibers isomorphic iff parameters lie in the same automorphism orbit.
status_evidence.claim: Algebraic families of biholomorphic but non-isomorphic exotic affine spheres exist, but for spheres rather than for exotic C^n's.

status_evidence.title: Biholomorphic non-algebraically isomorphic varieties
status_evidence.snippet: Danielewski surfaces x^2 z - y^2 = a and x^2 z - (1+x) y^2 = a are biholomorphic but not algebraically isomorphic.
status_evidence.claim: Biholomorphic but algebraically non-isomorphic affine surfaces exist, though Danielewski surfaces are not exotic C^2's.
